items.title: Introducing MongoDB Atlas Sharding Advisor: Know When and How to Scale Sharded Clusters
items.summary: As applications grow, database teams need to make increasingly complex decisions about how to distribute data, manage workloads, and scale their infrastructure. Sharding enables MongoDB to scale horizontally, but managing a sharded cluster can introduce its own challenges. Understanding cluster health, diagnosing uneven load, and choosing an appropriate shard key can require piecing together metrics across multiple views and relying on specialized expertise.
